title: Occult Ritual Circle
description: A surreal black and white scene shows a large circular metallic platform with alchemical and zodiac symbols. At the center a horned demonic figure with multiple arms sits in a meditative pose, flanked by two silhouetted hooded figures holding glowing rings, all surrounded by floating wind turbines, papers, and ink splatters against a dark background.
prompt: Surreal black and white occult scene featuring a large circular metallic platform engraved with zodiac and alchemical symbols. A multi-armed horned demonic entity sits in lotus position at the center with dark ink splatters, flanked by two silhouetted hooded figures holding glowing rings. Floating wind turbines, scattered papers and ink effects fill the dark background in a detailed ink drawing style.
